Condition: Final dmg 60%(rouse) / Crit dmg 254% (80% is unique effect of WoD) / Vulnerable applied (image 4)

In this case, the description of OE saying 200080 dmg (image 1)
So, the damage in my expectation was [ 200080 * 1.5 * 3.54 ] = 1062425
but actual dmg was 1281197 (image 2, 3)

this lack is because description of OE doesn't apply own buff to dmg

1281197 / 3.54 / 1.5 = 241280....
( 241280 - 200080 ) / 1.6 / 50 = 515 (same as it's str buff)

Anyway, 20%, 218k gap has occurred in this case
and It's enough to confuse players decision of "can I finish with this?"

I think this is a kind of bug and should be improved
